info.description: The Financial Market Analysis API enables users to submit and analyze financial market data effectively. This API facilitates the creation of analyses that help businesses evaluate market trends and make informed decisions. Typical consumers include financial analysts, investment firms, and data researchers who rely on timely and accurate market insights. By leveraging this API, users can streamline their analytical processes and enhance their strategic planning through data-driven approaches.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new financial market analysis. It accepts parameters necessary for generating insights and forecasts based on the latest financial data.

requestBody.description: The request body for creating a new financial market analysis. This should include details such as the market parameters and any specific considerations relevant to the analysis being requested.
